title: Parts given out orally on record dates; no written bass part
summary: On sessions Duke dictated notes at the piano; he never wrote a bass part until later years.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Well, on a record session, then, you'd go on a record session, he'd just give out notes, sit there at the piano and say, 'You play this,' you know, different guys. 'Your part is this, your part is that.' So it never was written out.
No. That was -- I can remember that being hard on the bass players sometimes. When he had some of those real funny chord progressions going, and calling for the bass player to fall in with him.
He never wrote a bass part until later years.
But he didn't want them playing just straightforward chords, did he?
No. He'd think that they should know.
